value.rationale: Unweighted cycles form a canonical connected regular graph-entropy benchmark for color-based trace approximation. Unlike generic O(m^-2) probing bounds, the exact entropy error decays at the sharp cubic rate with coefficient 2 zeta(3)(1-L^-3), and is maximized in a sharp limiting sense over all multiples of a coloring period. For the natural two-vertex class case, the same matrix-function evaluation budget admits an exactly quantified unbiased binomial randomization and RMSE Delta_m/sqrt(m). These provide structural benchmarks and risk calibration, not arbitrary slices or renamings.
